usedFor: SprintOps holds tasks, and MSG91 opens a ticket through “Send Mail via Hello” after “When a new task is created”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new task is created” in SprintOps, then “Send Mail via Hello” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: A new task opens a ticket, or replies to one with its ticket ID.

watchOut: “When a task is updated” fires on every edit, so one task can reach “Send Mail via Hello” repeatedly.
